import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Switch to the Actions tab to set the discount
    actions_tab_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='The information in this tab has been changed. This tab contains invalid data. Please solve the problem before saving. Actions')
    await actions_tab_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the tab to load
    
    # In the Actions tab, set the discount to 20%
    # First, find the 'Apply' combobox and select 'Percent of product price discount'
    apply_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Apply')
    await apply_combobox.select_option('Percent of product price discount')
    
    # Then, fill the 'Discount Amount' textbox with '20'
    discount_amount_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Discount Amount')
    await discount_amount_textbox.fill('20')
    
    # Save the rule
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save')
    await save_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for save to complete
